newsitem.title: USA: Request filed for review of US credit union ruling.
newsitem.headline: Request filed for review of US credit union ruling.

text.p: The National Credit Union Administration said Wednesday that it and the Justice Department had filed a request with the Supreme Court to review a lower court ruling that the NCUA's membership and expansion policy was illegal.
The American Bankers Association had sued the regulator of credit unions in U.S. District court for allowing credit unions to add members from unrelated fields.
The Supreme court was asked to rule on whether banks had standing to challenge the NCUA's interpretation of the Federal Credit Union Act that defines credit union membership.

The NCUA and the Justice Department also asked the Supreme Court whether the NCUA permissibly interpreted the act's common bond provision to permit membership to consist of multiple groups. so long as each group has its own common bond.
